changes.title: MRCOG Planning Areas and Roadway Functional Classification
changes.description: Maps Albuquerque’s metropolitan planning boundary, adjusted urban areas, roadway functional classifications, and regional jurisdictions. This live MRCOG viewer provides searchable geography, a legend, and layer controls. Road ownership is modeled and not authoritative; roads omitted from the classification layer should be treated as local.

scope_assessment.geographic_institutional_scope: MRCOG and MRMPO regional transportation planning, explicitly including the Albuquerque metropolitan planning and adjusted urban areas.
scope_assessment.specific_albuquerque_connection: Actual public map draws the Albuquerque Metropolitan Planning Area, Albuquerque Adjusted Urban Area, and classified Albuquerque street network; search Albuquerque zoomed to that network.
scope_assessment.abqinfo_public_information_value: Enables readers to distinguish street functional classifications, urban/rural geography and the planning jurisdictions underlying Albuquerque transportation policy and programming.
scope_assessment.general_context_exclusion_test: This is substantive mapped Albuquerque policy geography and street data, rather than incidental city references, statewide applicability or a generic regional basemap.
scope_assessment.substantive_rationale: A resident can compare Albuquerque streets and planning boundaries directly, interpret classifications through a working legend and read the publisher's adoption and data limitations. This adds a current interactive classification reference beyond the archived boundary and future-network maps.

quality_assessment.document_function: Maintained live geographic reference for transportation planning areas and roadway functional classification.
quality_assessment.substantive_content: Twelve anonymously queryable operational layers, ten top-level layer-list entries, six functional-class legend classes, and substantial explanatory notes on boundaries, data dates and ownership limitations.
quality_assessment.durable_public_usefulness: Supports local interpretation of metropolitan jurisdiction, adjusted urban areas and Albuquerque roadway hierarchy; keep it clearly labeled as a maintained live map.
quality_assessment.information_density: Dense visual local network and boundary information plus explanatory context; not a software shell or administrative fragment.
quality_assessment.unique_information: Roadway functional classification and current planning-area overlays complement archived AMPA boundary and adopted future-network maps without replacing them.
quality_assessment.rationale: The actual rendered map provides substantive Albuquerque street and jurisdiction information with a working legend, layer panel and Albuquerque search. One live entry presents this integrated resource without multiplying its underlying web map and service layers into separate public entries.
quality_assessment.measured_content_note: Live application: zero PDF pages; word count is rendered explanatory sidebar text, not a static-document page measurement.
quality_assessment.family_review: Underlying Planning Areas Map and twelve service layers are components of this one app. Archived AMPA boundary and 2026 long-range system maps are distinct dated/contextual references; no settled original is replaced.
